response.justification: Bogdan is a seasoned, versatile software engineer (~18 years) with strong production engineering credentials, staff-level experience, and recent hands-on exposure to MCP servers and agentic tooling at re:cinq. However, the role requires 8+ years building AI-driven solutions, and his AI/GenAI experience appears to span roughly one year, with no demonstrated depth in RAG architectures, vector databases, LLM evaluation pipelines, or multi-agent frameworks. His customer-facing and mentoring background partially offsets this, but the core AI experience gap is significant for a Staff GenAI role.
strengths: 18+ years of production software engineering across web, backend, and high-throughput distributed systems
Current hands-on work with MCP code generators and agentic-workflow infrastructure at re:cinq
Strong TypeScript/Node.js expertise plus cloud/DevOps experience (AWS CDK, Kubernetes, Docker)
concerns: Falls far short of 8+ years building AI-driven solutions; GenAI exposure is only ~1 year
No evidence of vector database, RAG, or LLM evaluation/observability experience
Limited demonstrated Python usage and no explicit multi-agent framework experience (LangGraph, CrewAI)

key_factors.factor: Strong production engineering and cloud background
Recent MCP and agentic tooling exposure
